purpose: Three Olivia Arcana identity and card-back concepts

deliverables.title: The inlaid monogram
deliverables.card_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished, original tarot CARD BACK for Olivia Arcana. Portrait aspect ratio 7:12, full card artwork fills the whole image, straight orthographic front view, no surrounding scene, no perspective, no hands or mockup. A real designed reverse, with a strong integrated surface composition, not an illustration inside a picture frame. Use half-turn (180-degree rotational) symmetry in the major forms so there is no preferred upright direction. This deck has midnight lapis-blue grounds, finely carved warm ivory, restrained pale antique gold. Exquisite shallow relief and precise material joins, soft diffuse raking light that reveals engraving without a spotlight or glow. Graceful contours, clarity at card size, beautiful detail up close. No typography, no captions, no random occult symbols, no stars or space imagery, no archways or curtains, no leaves added merely as filler, no thick bevelled border, no heavy distressed texture, no fake cracks, no over-sharpening. This is contemporary authored collectible design, with fine craft rather than fantasy-prop styling.
Direction A — THE INLAID MONOGRAM. A bespoke O/A symbol formed from ONE generous oval curved ivory stroke and ONE crisp oblique cut. The cut and a short structural junction suggest A inside the O through negative space; it must be elegant, unusual and legible as a single emblem, not a font placed over a circle. Make two opposed, connected instances of that emblem organise the complete card back, upper left and lower right, paired by a half-turn. Large deep-blue and warm-ivory shapes occupy the surface; their long curves have deliberate transitions into straight edges. Narrow pale gold inlays trace only three or four carefully chosen seams. Bundles of hair-fine engraved parallel lines follow the ends of the major curves and softly change the tone of selected blue areas, taking a lesson from precise katagami cutting. Sophisticated geometric bookbinding structure: broad masses versus tiny line detail, asymmetry within each half, exact overall balance. Neither a centred medallion nor an empty oval surrounded by ornament. Restrained satin lapis, porcelain-like matte ivory, clean flush marquetry with subtly recessed seams. The design should look like a singular work by a skilled contemporary bookbinder and identity designer, not a generic Art Deco template. No fans or sunbursts or scattered gold dots. Give the primary O/A geometry confidence and generosity; leave blue breathing space integrated between the large inlaid shapes.
deliverables.emblem_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Supporting reference image: the newly created Olivia Arcana inlaid card back. Extract and faithfully refine ONLY ONE of its distinctive O/A monograms: the tall oval ivory curved stroke with the oblique rising cut and small inner angular junction. Create a single isolated matching emblem as a square brand concept image. Preserve the distinctive tall proportions, asymmetrical stroke taper and crisp internal blue negative space; do not use a generic typeface or draw a different A. Exactly one upright symbol, centred with 22 percent breathing room on every side, on a perfectly uniform midnight blue background. Warm matte ivory inlaid shape and a very narrow pale gold seam, very shallow sculptural depth with soft even lighting. Remove the entire card repeat, surrounding sweeping ivory shapes, engraving trails and all surface noise. No text, no wordmark, no card border, no presentation labels. A clean, highly legible brand emblem derived from this actual design.

deliverables.title: The living weave
deliverables.card_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished, original tarot CARD BACK for Olivia Arcana. Portrait aspect ratio 7:12, full card artwork fills the whole image, straight orthographic front view, no surrounding scene, no perspective, no hands or mockup. A real designed reverse, with a strong integrated surface composition, not an illustration inside a picture frame. Use half-turn (180-degree rotational) symmetry in the major forms so there is no preferred upright direction. This deck has midnight lapis-blue grounds, finely carved warm ivory, restrained pale antique gold. Exquisite shallow relief and precise material joins, soft diffuse raking light that reveals engraving without a spotlight or glow. Graceful contours, clarity at card size, beautiful detail up close. No typography, no captions, no random occult symbols, no stars or space imagery, no archways or curtains, no leaves added merely as filler, no thick bevelled border, no heavy distressed texture, no fake cracks, no over-sharpening. This is contemporary authored collectible design, with fine craft rather than fantasy-prop styling.
Direction B — THE LIVING WEAVE. Invent a distinctive paired organic emblem: two slender continuous tapered forms turn around one another without touching at their finest tips; the opening between them is itself a beautiful, recognisable flowing lozenge. A subtle botanical character comes from lanceolate taper, not literal vines or a wreath. Derive a continuous interlocking surface from this one emblem. Three generous staggered repetitions along the height, one-and-a-half across the width, meet through shared contours and deliberate over-under joints. The blue negative spaces form a second rhythm of larger flowing shapes, like a textile carefully designed by hand. Each paired unit turns into its neighbour; the major layout repeats under a 180-degree rotation. Some forms are warm ivory with a fine interior incised vein, some are dark blue low relief, with gold appearing only at a few tiny inner junctions. LARGE sculptural ribbon-like silhouettes, extremely delicate taper, tactile carved satin surfaces, hierarchy between generous quiet areas and closely engraved details. Expressive, sensual, botanical abstraction with subtle physical depth. It must be clearly unlike a geometric O/A monogram or a field of banknote scrolls. No conventional fleur-de-lys, paisley, acanthus, peacock or fish; no loose sprigs, olives, tangled vines, radial rosette or large empty centre. Shape the whole rectangular surface, including its edge terminations, with the logic of an original interlocking pattern.
deliverables.emblem_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Supporting reference image: the newly created Olivia Arcana living-weave card back. Derive a SINGLE isolated matching emblem from ONE paired interlocking motif in the centre of this reference. Two elegant elongated ivory leaf-ribbon forms curve around one another; their sharp tapered tips define a flowing almond/lozenge-shaped midnight-blue opening. Preserve the reference's supple contour and very slight carved vein; reduce the repeated pattern to one complete graceful unit. Single upright sculptural brand emblem, square image, centred with at least 23 percent empty space on each side, on a uniform midnight blue ground. Warm matte ivory and one minute gold junction, fine shallow carving, soft even light. The emblem should be readable in silhouette, not a cluster of leaves. Do not create a wreath, star, flower, fleur-de-lys, literal olive branch, infinity sign or extra ornament. No text, no card border, no presentation labels. Keep direct visual kinship to the supplied card back.
deliverables.background_cleanup_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Fix ONLY the background of this supplied Olivia Arcana emblem. Preserve the exact paired ivory leaf-like ribbons, carving, shape, proportions, tiny gold tip details and placement. Replace EVERY background pixel, including the opening between the ribbons and all the space around them, with a single UNIFORM SOLID midnight navy colour #06182f. The entire square canvas must be FULLY OPAQUE, including all four corners. No transparency and no alpha fade anywhere. No vignette, no pale haze or clouds, no diffuse glow or spotlight, no shadow outside the symbol. There must be a crisp natural edge between the ivory symbol and the uniform blue ground. Keep the original square composition. Do not change the drawing of the symbol or add anything. Deliver the completed opaque image.

deliverables.title: The engraved field
deliverables.base_card_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original finished playing-card reverse for Olivia Arcana, portrait 7:12 ratio, artwork fills whole image, straight-on flat orthographic view with no mockup. The direction is THE ENGRAVED FIELD: an original paired calligraphic seal expressed through extremely precise engraving. Build the whole design from two opposed elongated blade-like ivory curved shapes, related by a half-turn, their narrow waists creating a clean dark blue hourglass opening in the centre. Think two sharp sweeping pen strokes turning toward one another, weight concentrated into one broad graceful curve each and then thinning to hair-fine points. From the ends of these two strokes emerge only four long continuous return loops. The loops flow through the card's outer quarters and link to exactly the same central strokes, forming a connected fine structure from top to bottom. Inside the ivory blades: tiny tightly spaced intaglio engraving following the curved form. In the blue field: related curves drawn as very fine paired gold lines. Hierarchy: two bold ivory gestures, four fine connected loops, exquisite microscopic interior hatching. Half-turn symmetry in the major drawing. This is intelligent calligraphic geometry, not Victorian floral scrollwork. No flowers, leaves, petals, acanthus, fleurs-de-lys, medallions, generic damask, curls ending in round blobs, circles, sun, stars, eyes, frilly swirls, bordered frames, arches or curtains. Midnight lapis blue flat ground with subtle fine material grain, warm ivory shallow inlay, very fine muted gold engraving. Very shallow physical relief, gentle even raking light. Beautiful severe contours, clear negative-space channels, no global shine, no glow, no fake aging. Preserve the feeling of a richly engraved authentic card back, but make the central two-gesture seal the unmistakable identity. No lettering or captions.
deliverables.final_card_edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this supplied original Olivia card-back concept. Preserve EXACTLY the two large central ivory calligraphic blades: their shapes, engraving, position, graceful taper, central meeting, half-turn pairing. Preserve the portrait rectangle and midnight blue / ivory / pale gold palette. Make the surrounding field substantially richer and more intricately engraved while keeping that central seal dominant. Inside each of the four large blue looped regions, add two smaller curved ivory inlay blades that follow the main long curve and turn inward; they have the same taper and fine internal hatching as the central shapes. Their ends link back into the fine gold loop lines. Between these smaller inlays, draw very delicate tight parallel engraved curve bands, directionally organised like fine engine-turning. Each part is connected to the same flowing calligraphic structure. Carefully alternating blue openings remain visible and the composition reads clearly at card size. Maintain 180-degree paired composition. This should now be a RICH ENGRAVED FIELD rather than a nearly empty background, about 40 percent ivory/engraving, 60 percent blue open channels. Fine sophisticated card-back craft. Remove all diffuse luminous halos around the forms; material depth comes from clean subtle recesses and minuscule edge highlights. No floral acanthus, no flowers, no leaves, no stock Victorian scrollwork, no circular beads, no borders or lettering, no extra medallion. One coherently constructed dense but graceful calligraphic surface, with lovely large and small shapes.
deliverables.emblem_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Derive a single clean matching brand emblem from the two CENTRAL opposed ivory engraved blades in the supplied Olivia Arcana card-back concept. Preserve their exact flowing shape, narrow connection, taper, opposing orientation and directional internal hatching. Isolate that central pair only, centred in a square image with generous empty blue background around it. Remove the four large surrounding gold loop outlines and all other card composition. The pair should read as one slender expressive vertically flowing S-shaped seal, with a tiny gold junction and precisely incised lines in matte warm ivory. Uniform midnight blue ground, soft even light, shallow carving, crisp graceful contour. No glow, no rays, no stage, no border, no typography or labels, no added leaf or fleur-de-lys motifs. Matching sculptural identity concept for this exact reverse.

note: Emblems were generated using their corresponding card artwork as a visual reference. C's final card and emblem were derived from its calligraphic study. PNG concepts; not vector masters or prepress files.
